versions.changelog:
v0.1.3 adds improved self-hosting support and updates onboarding security.

- Updated to clarify support for both Vexa Cloud and self-hosted instances.
- Onboarding now instructs users to set up API keys themselves (never paste keys into chat).
- Improved documentation for environment variable setup and secrets management.
- Minor text and security clarifications throughout onboarding and setup references.
v0.1.2: Added .clawhubignore to exclude secrets/ from published package. Fixes security flag.
v0.1.1: Added Zoom support, recordings (list/get/delete/download/config), meeting bundle command, simplified description, environment switching
